'''"The Visitors"''' was the name the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] gave to [[Jorj Car'das]] and [[Maris Ferasi]], the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] who revealed the existence of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to the Chiss and taught them [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>
